payload.title: Working with GeoSeries
payload.summary: This notebook introduces the GeoSeries class, an extension of the Series object in the Pyleoclim library, designed to handle geoscientific time series with additional metadata such as geolocation. It demonstrates how to instantiate GeoSeries from LiPD datasets and explores functionalities like mapping and analyzing geospatial collections. The notebook also covers the creation and manipulation of MultipleGeoSeries objects, which bundle multiple GeoSeries for comprehensive geospatial analysis.
goals: Introduce the GeoSeries class and its functionalities.
Demonstrate loading and handling geoscientific data using GeoSeries.
Showcase mapping and geospatial analysis capabilities.
Illustrate the use of MultipleGeoSeries for bundled geospatial data.
